title: Bael'dun Digsite
wikitext:
[[File:Bael'dun Digsite.jpg|thumb|The Bael'dun Digsite]]

The '''Bael'dun Digsite''' is an excavation site of the [[Dwarf|dwarven]] [[Bael'dun|expedition]] based at [[Bael Modan]]. It is a large quarry dug into the mountainside in the western edge of [[Mulgore]].{{co|33|47|Mulgore}} This incursion was against the warnings of [[Baine Bloodhoof]], who saw the excavations as an affront to the [[Earth Mother]], and as diplomatic solutions failed, the [[Bloodhoof tribe]] resolved to drive the invaders out by taking and breaking their pickaxes. The dwarves refused to heed the tauren's warnings and their reckless digging infuriated the spirits of the land and killed them.
